# Aegis SSH v0.4.0

- Adds automatic configuration, status, repair, and removal for Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, VS Code, and OpenClaw.
- Adds checksum-verified one-line GitHub installation, update, and uninstall commands.
- Embeds the managed Agent Skill in the standalone binary and preserves unmanaged same-name Skills.
- Keeps updated brokers locked until the user explicitly unlocks them.
